description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for testing the PayGradeCurrencyAPI endpoint in the OrangeHRM project. It defines multiple test methods for CRUD operations (getOne, getAll, create, update, delete) using data providers. The class extends EndpointIntegrationTestCase, indicating it performs integration tests of the API.
